Technology plays a significant role in our lives today and is expected to become even more essential in the future. Humans have always aimed to improve their quality of life and make everyday tasks simpler. While some believe technological advancements are beneficial, others argue they have negative effects, such as reducing face-to-face interactions, encouraging people to stay indoors glued to devices, and sometimes causing aggressive behavior when technology use is restricted.

In earlier times, people used to meet regularly in the streets and public spaces. There was no technology that allowed us to see friends on a small screen and talk from a distance with just a ring. Nowadays, this shift is seen as problematic because many prefer staying at home, interacting online with people they do not truly know, instead of going outside to socialize or enjoy their surroundings. Some argue that chatting with strangers online is similar to speaking to unfamiliar people on the street. However, online interactions carry risks, like encountering fake profiles used to steal personal information. When meeting someone face-to-face, we could observe their behavior and get a better sense of who they were, which helped build genuine friendships—something much harder to achieve in the virtual world.

When we were children, playing outside was a common source of fun—whether in the streets, visiting friends, or going to the park. But things have changed considerably since then. The rise of video games has made indoor gaming extremely popular among kids and teenagers. All they need is to connect a device to the TV and start playing. Unfortunately, some spend all day gaming and don’t want to participate in outdoor sports or visit friends in person. At school, conversations often revolve around video games, which can negatively impact their academic performance, since spending too much time playing leaves less time for studying or completing homework. When the first game consoles arrived, they were a novelty, but many children couldn’t afford them and chose to save money for treats or outings instead. Today, however, it seems many young people prefer being anywhere technology is available rather than going outside.

Because of how widespread technology has become, a new behavior has emerged where some children and teens respond aggressively if their access to devices is restricted. Many families face problems when children become angry or upset after being told to stop using technology, a reaction that is increasingly common worldwide. Doctors explain this behavior by saying children get deeply involved in their virtual worlds, where they feel free to do what they want until parents interrupt their experience. Since technology is available almost everywhere, it is challenging for parents to limit its use. In some cases, teens get so frustrated during gaming that they end up damaging furniture or breaking the devices they were using, even if the devices were gifts from their parents.

Some people argue that technology has a positive impact on our lives by creating tools that simplify daily activities. However, technology can have harmful effects because it reduces real human interactions and encourages us to take the easiest route in life. If we don’t find ways to manage our use of technology, it could negatively affect the way society functions in the future.

That can really affect them because they don't give enough truth to their parents about what is going on in their lives. Anything can be happening. Educators feel that students' breaks are too short. That is the first reason why students' breaks should not be year-round school and why there should be a 3-4 week break in the summer and a week off in spring and fall.

Finally, the second reason is that most students also have responsibilities. Students have lives and things to do. During summer, spring, and winter breaks, most students try to help their parents around the house and use their free time how they want. They don't have to stress as much over homework and projects. Most students also believe everything they learn at school is not worthy information, which is why they come back and forget most of what they learned. This is the last reason.

Although some people feel that summer break is too long and that students do not retain information as easily when they return in the fall, others believe otherwise. The fact remains that educators shouldn't make students' breaks year-round school. There should be a 3-4 week break in the summer and a week off in spring and fall because students don't have enough time to spend with their families and most students also have responsibilities. That is why they shouldn't remove summer, spring, and winter breaks.

Many students look forward to summer vacation, yet some educators argue that the long break causes students to forget what they have learned and that the summer holiday is too lengthy. However, it is important to consider students' perspectives. Educators often overlook how students feel about this issue. In my opinion, schools should not switch to year-round schooling without a significant summer break. Instead, students should have a three to four-week break in the summer and shorter breaks during spring and fall because they need time to spend with their families and manage their personal responsibilities.

One key reason is that students miss valuable family time during the school year. After school, students often have to focus on homework and prepare for the next day, which takes away from the time they can spend with their parents. Sometimes, they also have to work on projects, which add to their stress and limit their interaction with family members. As a result, important family connections may weaken, and students might not share what is happening in their lives with their parents. Many educators believe the breaks in school are too brief, but it is essential to maintain the summer holiday for family bonding, with one to two weeks off in spring and fall as well.

Another reason is that students have other responsibilities outside of school. Breaks in summer, spring, and winter provide them with a chance to relax, assist their parents, and use their free time as they wish. Without the pressure of schoolwork, they can enjoy a much-needed pause. Furthermore, many students feel that much of what they learn in school is not very useful, which is why they forget most of it over the break. This shows that long breaks help them refresh and prepare for the next term better.

Although some people argue that the summer vacation is too long and students lose knowledge during this period, I believe otherwise. The reality is that keeping a three to four-week summer break, along with shorter breaks in spring and fall, is important. Students need this time for family connections and to handle their personal duties. Therefore, removing or shortening these breaks would not be beneficial for students’ overall well-being.

Some schools now allow students to attend classes from home through online platforms or video conferencing, and I believe this is a very positive development. This option can be especially helpful for students who find it difficult to follow the traditional school schedule. Many students face challenges such as a lack of resources, limited time, or personal circumstances that prevent them from attending classes in person, and this alternative makes it possible for them to complete their education.

Online classes are a great solution for students who want to finish school but cannot be physically present. They allow students to study from home and choose times that fit their schedules. Time is often a major obstacle for students who drop out; many have to work after school and cannot dedicate enough hours to homework or other school tasks. As a result, they begin falling behind in their studies and eventually decide to quit school and focus on their jobs to support their families. For some students, family obligations and financial difficulties are key reasons for leaving school. Others may have emigrated without any family support and thus need to balance work and study to send money back home. With online learning, these students now have a chance to continue their education.

Video conferencing is another useful option for students to keep learning. Similar to online classes, this mode allows students to join lessons from home at times that work for them or according to the teacher’s schedule. What makes video calls beneficial is that students participate in real-time classes where they can see and interact with teachers through a camera. This makes it easier to ask questions and clarify doubts, much like being in a physical classroom.

One of the strengths of these options is that students can study while continuing to work or manage their personal responsibilities. Another advantage is that this approach is not only for young people; adults who left school earlier due to age or other reasons can also enroll and complete their high school education. Traditional schools might have rules about age limits, but remote learning opens the door for everyone to participate.

Nowadays, many teenagers leave school early, sometimes because they have no alternatives and sometimes due to lack of motivation. However, with schools offering these remote learning options, students who have previously dropped out and other individuals can benefit and have an easier path to finish their education, improving their chances for a better future.

I believe that if more schools provide distance learning as an option, more people will be able to take part and benefit from these programs, leading to greater opportunities in their lives. Since schools are now making this possible, there is no longer a valid excuse for not completing one’s education.

Some schools in the United States offer the option of attending classes from home, believing it to be beneficial for students. This approach has been used, in part, to reduce bullying, especially in middle and high schools where some students face harassment. Many students prefer learning from home because they want to avoid school, but studying remotely does not always lead to effective learning. Schools use distance learning tools like online lessons or video calls to connect with students at home. However, students often face distractions and challenges in the home environment. While some may find home more relaxing, many experience increased pressure and difficulty focusing.

One reason students get easily distracted at home is the availability of phones and other devices. Staying at home for long periods can lead to boredom, and students may find it hard to stay engaged. If they are tired or choose to sleep during online classes, the likelihood of paying attention decreases. Additionally, some students who work outside of school feel exhausted and less motivated to participate in learning.

Attention problems exist both in traditional classrooms and home learning. At home, students might listen to music or play games instead of concentrating on lessons. The home setting can make it even more challenging to remain attentive.

The learning environment also impacts how well students understand lessons. In a physical classroom, teachers can explain topics directly, which helps students grasp difficult concepts more easily. Online learning, on the other hand, often makes comprehension harder. Many students struggle to understand lessons delivered remotely, increasing their frustration and reducing the effectiveness of studying.

Despite these drawbacks, some schools still see remote learning as a good choice. Students can enjoy a more comfortable and safe space at home with their family. Home learning can also provide extra time for homework and allow students to rest better, helping them to be more energetic during lessons. However, being close to family members can also cause distractions that limit focus.

In conclusion, although online classes from home might seem convenient, students often find it difficult to concentrate due to distractions and lack of a proper learning atmosphere. Many do not want to engage in online learning because it feels harder to understand and less motivating. The presence of phones and other diversions, combined with the challenges of grasping subjects remotely, suggests that learning from home is not always the best option. Students may become frustrated and perform poorly when they cannot learn effectively in a home setting.

Students who live far away or struggle with learning often find it difficult to succeed in their classes. Teachers become concerned about these students and try various methods to support them. When they see that test scores are very low, they report the issue to the principal. To address this problem, a meeting is held, and it is suggested that students complete their assignments at home through a program called Home School.

Home School is designed to let students do their homework, quizzes, assignments, and tests at home. This program aims to help students succeed by giving them flexibility. Many students feel that home schooling is easier than attending traditional school. One of the advantages is that they can stay at home, eat lunch whenever they want, watch TV, and still have enough time to finish their assignments.

However, some students do not prefer home schooling because they find it boring to stay at home. They miss out on making friends, need support with their homework, and feel they do not receive enough information. Often, students opt for home schooling because there are no schools nearby, but parents want the best education for their children and are willing to do whatever is necessary to help them succeed.

If I were asked for advice on this issue, I would recommend that students attend regular school. Traditional schooling offers better opportunities to succeed, allows students to socialize and get help from their friends, and improves their chances of going to college. Teachers provide more support and information that prepares students for the future. Although the Home School program can be useful in supporting students, it may not be the best option long-term. People should take regular schooling seriously if they want to have greater chances of success.

Should students be praised regardless of how poor their work is? Although this might seem like a good idea at first, in reality, it is harmful within the educational context. As human beings, we all desire recognition for our efforts, and improvement comes from practicing repeatedly. This progress is encouraged when we feel satisfied, and that satisfaction often arises from receiving praise. However, if students only ever hear positive feedback without any guidance on how to improve, learning loses its purpose. Continually being told “this is perfect” or receiving an A+ for every assignment can lead to stagnation. Students might become unwilling to accept criticism and could develop a need for constant attention.

An excellent illustration of this is found in the world of artists. Artists often dislike their own creations, even when they show real progress. They do receive praise, but what truly motivates them is their dissatisfaction with their work. This critical view pushes them to improve, and they learn to handle feedback constructively, using it to enhance their skills. Drawing from this example, it’s clear that blindly praising students is not helpful. The goal of education is to prepare students for the real world, where not everyone will praise them. If they cannot handle criticism, they may struggle in their careers or even risk losing their jobs.

In conclusion, I am not suggesting that too much praise is harmful, nor that students should be made to dislike their efforts. Instead, I believe that every compliment should be accompanied by constructive criticism. This balance teaches students that with every positive aspect, there can also be something to improve on, reflecting the reality that the world is not made up of constant praise alone.

Personally, when I don’t get enough rest, I find it hard to concentrate in class, which affects my academic performance. Staying awake late also disconnects me from the world around me because when others are awake, I am often tired or asleep.

This curfew can also positively influence teenagers’ eating habits. Being out late often leads to consuming unhealthy fast food, which is harmful to their health. Along with proper rest, eating nutritious food is vital to staying energetic and strong. It is important for young people to maintain a healthy diet because they have their whole lives ahead of them, and poor eating habits can lead to early illnesses. Besides food, teenagers hanging out with friends sometimes indulge in alcohol, which is inappropriate at a young age. Junk food weakens the immune system and increases the likelihood of diseases at a young age. Moreover, eating unhealthy food can cause weight gain that affects teenagers socially, mentally, and physically. When teens stay at home, they generally eat meals prepared by their parents, which tend to be healthier and less greasy. For example, whenever I eat unhealthy food, it makes me feel unwell, and being in unfamiliar places where no one knows me makes me uncomfortable. I have a family member who became overweight after eating too much junk food, and he now faces many difficulties such as needing help to stand up, being teased for his weight, and getting tired easily while walking. To avoid these problems and negative comments, teenagers should eat healthy, home-cooked meals.

Besides improving sleep and diet, a curfew encourages teens to spend more time with their families. This allows them to bond and communicate more instead of going out with friends. Often, a generation gap forms in families due to a lack of interaction. Sharing dinner together in the evening creates opportunities to talk about different topics. For instance, when my family and I gather, we discuss new experiences, like how my sister and I made new friends after moving this year. We also talk about how to stay safe from common illnesses and share any challenges we are facing. This kind of family time helps us share both our joys and problems and strengthens our relationships.

Many reasons show that introducing a curfew can guide teenagers towards a healthier and more positive lifestyle. Having enough sleep, eating nutritious food, and spending time with family are achievable if curfews are set. To build a future generation that is healthy and focused on personal growth and the progress of the country, such rules are necessary. Healthy teenagers will grow into alert and hardworking adults who can contribute greatly to society. If they rest well, they will be motivated to fulfill their dreams. Additionally, family interaction fosters happiness and satisfaction among all members. Teens should view this curfew as a helpful guideline rather than a restriction on their freedom. It is not about limiting their rights but about providing a path to a healthy, active, and balanced life. By imposing limits on unhealthy habits, we give teens a better chance at a long and fulfilling life.

Why is it important to have a positive attitude? First of all, having a good attitude can lead to greater success in life. Secondly, gaining respect from others is an important part of being successful. People who respect you are more likely to support your goals rather than trying to bring you down. However, respect is not given easily; you have to earn it by showing respect to others, helping them when needed, and maintaining a good attitude. This mutual respect creates a supportive environment that helps you achieve more in life.

Thirdly, having a positive attitude makes it easier to find a job or get accepted into a good college. Negative attitudes can create obstacles in these processes. For example, if you want to get your dream job or attend your preferred college, a good attitude can significantly improve your chances. Without it, you might face rejection or even be expelled.

In conclusion, I believe that having a positive attitude makes life much easier compared to having a bad one. A good attitude helps you build friendships, earn respect, and increases your chances of success in finding employment and other opportunities.

Have you ever considered how many people feel unhappy because they are not true to themselves? Today, millions of individuals around the world do not live the life they truly desire. In a society where being different is often viewed negatively, it can be challenging to remain authentic. However, the greatest achievement for any person is to embrace their uniqueness and individuality. Being oneself is the key to happiness, but fighting against widespread prejudice and accepting who you really are can feel like a battle when the world seems to want to change you.

Many believe that success and a fulfilling life come from having wealth, status, or material possessions. Yet, these things do not define a person or guarantee happiness. It is important to understand that without happiness, nothing else truly matters. Studies reveal that at least 60 percent of people are unhappy with their lives, but this can improve if individuals choose to be honest with themselves and remove unwanted influences. The first step toward happiness is being authentic. Living a lie toward oneself only leads to a miserable existence. Accepting your personality and interests based on your own thoughts is crucial. A serious consequence of not being true to oneself is mental illness, such as depression. This common and dangerous condition often arises from dissatisfaction with one’s life or identity. Despite the difficulty, being yourself is the most rewarding endeavor.

Throughout life, making decisions is inevitable, and it is vital to listen to your inner voice. No one should allow others to make important choices on their behalf, especially when those decisions affect who they are. Knowing exactly what you want and being content with yourself are essential components of happiness.

Prioritizing your own opinions is the secret to genuine happiness. It is easy to follow others’ advice based on their experiences or fall under the influence of a world that constantly tries to mold you into someone else. However, true happiness comes from pursuing what you truly desire.

Everyone is striving to find their right path in life, and being honest about your feelings and identity can guide you toward that goal. The world today is engaged in an ongoing struggle, as many people fight for their rights and strive to be truthful with themselves and others. Though this is not an easy task, the only person whose opinion you truly need to consider is yourself. Unfortunately, not everyone realizes this, and some hope for acceptance simply because they exist. It is difficult to remain true to oneself when society pressures you to change and refuses to embrace diversity. Yet, differences are natural and necessary for balance. We are each part of a community where learning about and respecting others, regardless of race, language, culture, or traditions, is what truly matters—not uniformity. Nowadays, many people are working to create a more inclusive world where prejudice no longer exists and everyone can be who they want to be, enjoying the rights they deserve. This battle is tough, but the outcome is worth it. When a person accepts themselves fully, including both strengths and flaws, studies show that external opinions cannot harm them. At that point, they have reached the pinnacle of personal achievement.

Philosophers and researchers often suggest that society’s problem with accepting differences stems from people hiding their true feelings and desires out of fear of rejection. Partly, this is also because individuals rarely speak up against injustice. However, it is never too late to change, and many are now trying to shift the world’s perspective on what should be accepted. For this reason, embracing who you are can feel like a struggle against the world. We must remain strong and not let anyone challenge our choices. Another reason it is hard to be yourself is because people are often their own harshest critics. If everyone were honest with themselves, individuality would be normal in society, but since it is so difficult to accept ourselves, being unique is often seen as wrong. We need to change this viewpoint and make acceptance the norm.

It is clear that there is still much to learn, but I believe we are moving in the right direction. People must overcome many challenges to establish their individuality while remembering their goals and where they want to go.

Being yourself is truly difficult when society insists that being different is unacceptable. How can you understand who you are if no one allows you the freedom to discover it? Nevertheless, finding this answer is the greatest achievement anyone can have, because living as your true self is the best path to a fulfilling life.

Similarly, guys who spend a lot of money on shoes, such as brands like Nike, Adidas, Jordan, or KD, often become annoyed if their expensive shoes, which might cost over $300, are ruined. They dislike it when people ruin their shoes or when they step in mud while wearing them. They prefer to keep their shoes clean and in good condition.

If guys know they will have to do outdoor or physical work, they should probably choose cheaper shoes, maybe between $20 and $50, instead of expensive ones. That way, they wouldn’t worry so much about damaging their shoes. People who do a lot of work or activities outside should be careful about what they buy, as expensive items require more care and attention.

Teenagers especially need to understand this because many tend to want expensive things but do not always want to work for them. Some teenagers ask their parents for costly shoes or other items without realizing how much effort it takes to earn money. It would be better if teenagers started working early to understand the value of money and possessions. When they buy things themselves, they learn to appreciate and take care of them.

Some students believe that saving energy and resources in schools is a good idea because it helps reduce energy consumption and preserve materials. However, I think this can cause problems for students who do not have computers or internet access at home and rely on the school to complete their homework. What happens if there is no power for the computers at school?

If the computers are not working, we might miss deadlines for homework and lose points. Imagine having no electricity for just two hours in a single school day—now think about four days in a row! This situation would be very difficult for students who depend on school resources to finish their assignments on time. It could also lead to stress and issues with parents.

Some students have access to computers and internet at home because their parents can afford it. That is probably why those students support saving energy in schools. However, many others cannot afford this, or their families face different challenges, such as having only one parent working, paying rent, car expenses, or bills. There are many reasons why some students do not have internet at home.

Although saving energy in schools is generally not a bad idea, it can create difficulties for students who need reliable resources to complete their homework comfortably. If electricity is out for several days, it becomes harder to finish tasks on time, especially because there are many students and limited computers. Not everyone can use the same computer at once, and some homework takes longer than others. Therefore, I believe saving energy this way may not be suitable for all students.

Some people argue against using too much energy because students might waste time on social media or games instead of studying. But it is unfair to generalize because many students use the internet at school for important activities like doing homework or reading books.

Another reason not to save energy by turning off devices is the air conditioning. Without electricity, the air conditioner will not work, and depending on the weather, this could affect both students and teachers. For example, if it is cold outside and there is no heater, people may get sick or have body pains. Also, without power, phones cannot be charged, so students cannot contact their parents or call for help in an emergency. Electricity is essential for communication and many important tasks.

On the positive side, schools can reduce energy use by limiting the time devices are on, which might lower electricity bills and save money for other school activities. They might also encourage more outdoor activities.

In conclusion, having no electricity for several days at school would make things difficult for students. While some businesses may be able to save energy easily because their conditions are different, schools need energy to support students’ learning and access to information.

Based on my experience, I agree with Emerson’s statement that our actions should be guided by what we have learned through experience. When you try new things and gain more experience, you are more likely to advance and take on higher positions. Experience provides the confidence and knowledge needed to move forward rather than remain stuck.

Without experience, a person is often unprepared and unable to fully accomplish tasks. I strongly believe that success depends on the support that experience gives. As you gain more practice and knowledge, opportunities increase, and you become ready to face various challenges. On the other hand, if someone lacks experience or proper preparation, it is difficult for them to progress or improve.

Experience helps a person become more capable and ready to take on new roles or responsibilities. However, this readiness does not come easily; it requires time and effort to develop skills through practice. Many people fail to advance because they are not prepared or have not completed the necessary learning process. Being well-prepared is essential for success, and experience is what builds this readiness.

Everyone needs to prepare themselves properly since reaching a good position is not simple. Gaining experience through learning and practice makes it easier to handle new challenges. Often, people who are not ready miss opportunities, which highlights the importance of preparation. In my view, having good experience starts with practicing and becoming familiar with your tasks.

When you do not understand something, it is important to ask questions—whether to a teacher, boss, or mentor—to clarify your doubts. Seeking guidance helps you complete your knowledge and improves your understanding. Many people benefit from this approach, but there are also those who do not take the time to practice or learn, and that prevents their growth.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that our actions and decisions should be based on the experience we acquire. Experience not only prepares us for future challenges but also opens doors to advancement and success. Without it, progress becomes very difficult, so gaining experience and being prepared are essential steps toward achieving one’s goals.

Technology can have both positive and negative effects on our lives. On the positive side, many people rely on technology daily, especially for staying in touch with friends and family who live far away. Technology also serves as a useful tool for many tasks, such as searching for books or shopping for items that would otherwise require visiting stores or malls. In this way, technology significantly influences society by making activities easier and more convenient. For instance, individuals can look for jobs online without needing to physically go out and search on the streets. Students can gather information about colleges without having to visit them personally, and people can shop from home instead of traveling long distances. Additionally, technology offers entertainment like games that help people relax and forget their problems, or it can assist with issues related to home maintenance.

However, technology also has a darker side that is often overlooked. Although it may seem harmless and trustworthy, there can be hidden dangers behind certain websites or platforms whose creators are unknown or have malicious intentions. Unfortunately, technology has been exploited for harmful purposes. For example, terrorist groups may use it to connect with young people and recruit them, especially targeting adolescents whose parents may not pay close attention to their online activities. In some cases, technology functions as a weapon. Many spend excessive time on social media or online shopping sites, but some individuals use these platforms to scam others by selling fake products and taking advantage of trusting customers.

In summary, technology has two sides: positive and negative. The impact it has depends on how we use it and what we choose to encounter when we engage with it.

On the other hand, I come from a country that does not have opportunities, but my goal is to be a better person today, tomorrow, and in my future.

I disagree with the statement that you must try something beyond what you have already mastered in order to grow. I believe that making mistakes and then having the chance to correct them is an essential part of growth, and everyone deserves multiple opportunities to improve.

To explain my point, imagine a group of students working on a class assignment. Each student has a different opinion, but only one acts as the leader. They must discuss the problem together and begin working. Since the group members have different ideas, their first attempt is not very good. When they present their work, the leader rejects it as incomplete. Instead of giving up, the students talk more about the topic and start working again. No one says, “I don’t want to do this” because everyone wants to prove themselves. Even if the first result is disappointing, they know they can try again. You should never feel like you can’t do something, because you always have the chance to improve and start over.

Secondly, sometimes we feel what we’ve done is wrong, but this doesn’t mean we can’t get better. Everyone in the world is given second, and even third chances to grow. Making a mistake the first time doesn’t mean you have to keep repeating it. You must work on improving yourself, your community, and your environment. For example, a person who has committed a crime and wants to educate themselves deserves the opportunity to learn and grow as a human being. Regardless of their past, they have the right to be treated fairly and to change for the better.

I know some people might disagree with me and believe that criminals should not receive second chances. However, I think they do because they are already paying for their mistakes through imprisonment and may wish to become better individuals. Everyone has a second chance. If you haven't succeeded at something, you should try again. Saying “I don’t want to do this” or “I can’t” is wrong. It is possible to accomplish many things in life. Those who oppose my view may find it annoying, but they should consider that nobody wants to be in prison and never learn something useful for the future. If they were in the same situation, they might also want another opportunity to improve—not just for themselves, but for others as well—to help make the world a better place.

In conclusion, people always have a chance to grow. As humans, we need to think about ourselves and also about others. This perspective can help make the world a better place to live. Many people in some countries are fortunate to have many opportunities to grow and prepare for the future. I come from a country where such opportunities are limited, but my goal remains the same: to become a better person today, tomorrow, and in the years to come.

This idea is inspiring and valuable for anyone aiming to reach their goals.

As teenagers grow and develop, they begin to form opinions about various issues.

It is not true to say that first impressions can hardly ever be changed.

You have the chance to become more friendly and approachable over time.

It is important to have a positive image in the eyes of others.

Sometimes, your facial expression might make you look sad or angry, even if you don’t mean to; this can be changed with time.

People may not understand when you don’t show happiness or when you face difficulties, but it is better to appear cheerful whenever possible.

When you behave kindly and smile in front of others, it reflects positively on you.

Your personality is usually the first thing people notice, which shapes their initial impression.

For example, if you work in a place where friendliness and smiling are important, you need to change your behavior to fit the environment; otherwise, people may not want to interact with you.

It is important to show that you are a nice person so others have a good opinion of you.

People appreciate when you come across as friendly and approachable, without any visible problems affecting your behavior.

Making a good first impression at any job is essential, as it influences how others treat you in the workplace.

In conclusion, it is not impossible to change the first impression that others have of you, as you can demonstrate through your actions that you are different from what they initially thought.

You have to follow rules, like arriving to your classes on time. If you don’t make it to class on time, then you have to go to the tardy table. If this happens more than three times, you have to go to ISS. ISS is a quiet room where you can’t have your phone and you can’t talk to anyone. If you don’t go to class at all, they will find you and put you in ISS. They will call or email your mom or dad to tell them that you weren’t in school. I don’t know about you, but my parents would get mad if they saw me go to school in the morning but found out I wasn’t actually attending classes.

When you disrespect your teacher, they will call security on you. They will come, get you, and talk to you. If you get in a fight with a student, you will get in big trouble. Security will come and get you, and if it is really bad, they will call an ambulance. At this time, the principal, police, and parents will get involved. The other person’s parents might press charges, and that would not be good for you. When you apply for college, they will see that you had a bad history, and they won’t want that type of behavior in their school. So, you would be hurting your future.

If you do drugs or sell drugs in school, then you would be in so much trouble with the school, police, and your parents. You could go to jail if you are older, and if you are dangerous, then you would definitely go to jail. You would probably be kicked out of school and have to go to a new school. You would lose all your friends because you wouldn’t have the same friends in the new school, and that would be very sad. You might also have to go to jail. 

So, I think it is better to go to online classes. Not that I get to eat all I want, but because there is a lot going on in schools that you have to go through and you might not like it. I think it would be a good experiment to try online classes.

Although some people believe that online classes are beneficial and have their reasons, they also come with drawbacks. Taking online classes has both advantages and disadvantages. When you study online, you can stay at home and avoid going to a school building. You don’t have to wake up early to catch the bus or see people you might not want to meet. Plus, you don’t need to eat the school lunch—you can eat whatever you want, whenever you want. Also, you don’t have to follow all the school rules; instead, you can set your own. It might even be easier to pass tests during online classes because you can look up information on the internet.

However, when you attend in-person school, your day is more structured. You have to wake up early, get ready, and catch the bus to make it to your classes on time. In school, you sit in a small classroom at a desk and complete your assignments while following the rules. For example, if you arrive late repeatedly, you might have to sit at a “tardy table,” and after several offenses, you could be sent to ISS, a quiet room where you cannot use your phone or talk to anyone. If you skip class entirely, the school will contact your parents to inform them. My parents would be upset if they knew I wasn’t at school when they saw me leave the house in the morning.

Disrespecting teachers can lead to further consequences—security might be called, and they would come to speak with you. Getting into fights with other students causes serious trouble too; security may intervene, and if the situation is severe, the ambulance, principal, police, and parents will get involved. The other student’s parents might even press charges. This kind of record could harm your reputation and chances when applying to colleges because schools prefer applicants with good behavior.

If a student uses or sells drugs at school, the consequences become even more severe, involving not just the school but also the police and parents. Depending on age and the situation, a student could be sent to jail. Such actions often result in being expelled and moving to a different school, meaning you lose your friends and familiar environment, which is very upsetting.

Considering all these challenges that can happen in schools, I believe online classes might be a better option. It’s not only about having the freedom to eat what you want, but also about avoiding the problems and strict rules that come with attending school. I think it would be worth trying online classes as an experiment.

Schools offer a variety of courses designed to help guide students toward specific professions. Thirdly, during the 9th and 10th grades, students take basic classes that help them gain knowledge and experience, making it easier to focus on their goals and prepare for the last two years of high school.

They help students understand the benefits of the career they want to pursue, including the potential income and opportunities for success after graduation. In the 11th and 12th grades, students take more challenging classes needed to graduate. The 11th grade tends to be more difficult, requiring the passing of two classes to move forward. By 12th grade, students attend classes recommended by counselors to prepare them for obtaining their chosen diploma, whether advanced or standard, according to their career plan.

In conclusion, I believe it is a wonderful idea to start considering your future career at a young age. It allows students to think about the right path and benefits related to their chosen profession. High school provides preparation based on what students plan to do after graduation, whether that involves going to college or vocational training. Having an early idea about a career helps students focus on their goals and turn their dreams into reality.

There are many career options available, and this is why I think students should begin choosing their interests when they enter high school. Teachers and counselors play an important role in guiding students to pick a career they are passionate about. When people seek advice, they often ask several individuals instead of just one. This happens because they want to receive good guidance to help them make the right decisions. Sometimes, when someone is going through difficulties, feeling depressed, or even experiencing happiness, they may struggle to control their emotions and thoughts. In such situations, they might panic and find it hard to decide what steps to take. This leads them to ask for advice from many different people. However, hearing multiple opinions can sometimes confuse them, making it difficult to choose which advice is best to follow. While it is helpful to get opinions from others, it can also be overwhelming. Therefore, it is important to carefully think about what to do next.

In my opinion, it is fine to ask others for their views, but we also need to use our own thinking. Without using our minds, we cannot make any decisions. We should consider each opinion and ask ourselves questions like: What are they really saying? Does this advice benefit me? Could following this cause problems? After reflecting on this, it is wise to talk to a close friend or a trusted person. If they agree, then you can feel more confident about taking that advice.

Instead of asking many people, it is better to seek opinions from just two or three individuals. If their suggestions don’t seem right, think independently and then make a smart decision. Everyone is responsible for their own choices. If you do want advice, try to find a trustworthy adult who sincerely wants to help you and offers good advice. Then, carefully think about what they said. If you believe their advice is right, follow it without hesitation.

For example, once I had to organize a birthday party, including choosing clothes for everyone and planning the event, but I was short on time and felt very confused. I asked friends, cousins, family members, and teachers for help, but I ended up with too many different opinions and couldn’t decide what to do. Finally, I spoke with my older cousin and discussed the situation. She explained everything clearly and helped me manage my time. Thanks to her advice, I was able to select the clothes and arrange the party within a week, and everything turned out great. This shows how seeking guidance from the right person can lead to better decisions.

If you find yourself confused, either try to think carefully on your own or ask someone reliable for help. Avoid asking random people you don’t know well because some might mislead you. That’s why I believe talking to a trusted adult is more effective than asking many people. In my first experience asking for advice, I lost time and got confused because I didn’t think carefully and listened to too many different voices. This taught me an important lesson: never do anything your parents or other responsible adults advise against.

Another important tip for making better choices is to listen to your parents and adults around you. Sometimes, a decision may seem good at first but later causes trouble. That is why it is better to follow the guidance of parents and adults rather than just doing what you feel like. It’s okay to listen to your feelings, but they are not always the best guide.

In summary, the best ways to make good decisions are these: first, listen carefully to your parents and other trusted adults; second, think carefully about whether the advice is good or bad; third, seek help from a kind and honest adult. Above all, believe in yourself and your faith. Trust that you and your parents want what is best for you. If you believe in yourself and your God, you will find support everywhere you go. These are the most reliable ways to make wise choices in life.

I agree with the idea that once someone feels they have mastered something, it can prevent them from growing further. From my perspective, becoming too comfortable or confident in one area might stop a person from improving or trying new things.

First, when people believe they have mastered a skill or job, they may stop pushing themselves to grow. For example, if you run your own business and notice that your sales are declining, you might feel stuck because you rely on familiar products and methods. This hesitation to explore new approaches can lead to feelings of frustration and make you doubt your ability to succeed, simply because you are focused on what’s not working rather than seeking improvement.

Second, being certain you have mastered something can also make it hard to accept feedback or change your methods. Imagine a situation where your friend points out a mistake or a better way to do something. If you feel overly confident in your current skills, you might reject their advice and miss the opportunity to learn. This attitude can prevent you from trying again or improving. For instance, students who score poorly on a test might feel discouraged and avoid retaking it, believing they already know their limits, which ultimately stops their progress.

Lastly, fear of failing again may hold people back from trying something they enjoy. Even if the first attempt was unsuccessful, trying again with more experience can lead to better results. Each failure teaches valuable lessons that help avoid repeating mistakes. It’s important to stay confident and open to learning, as this mindset allows growth no matter how many setbacks occur.

In conclusion, the key is not to give up on what you are working on, regardless of how many times you feel you have mastered or failed at it. There is always an opportunity to start over, improve, and believe in yourself. This belief is essential to continue growing and achieving your goals.

Ralph Waldo Emerson once said, "To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment." This quote is meant to inspire people who are reflecting on their lives and wondering whether it is better to work independently. I agree with this idea and would like to share my thoughts on why being true to yourself is a significant achievement.

Understanding this message is very important for everyone, especially when making decisions about the future. Before facing any challenges within organizations or society, it is essential to complete the work of discovering who you truly are and what your goals are. Emerson’s words encourage us to focus on ourselves first to avoid confusion or conflict later.

In my opinion, the greatest accomplishment is knowing your own purpose and preparing yourself to reach it. When you are clear about what you want to achieve in life, you can work hard to become successful in your chosen path, whether it’s in a company or any other field. Working diligently not only benefits you but also affects the people around you positively, including your family, who will be proud of your efforts.

It is important to think positively, stay motivated, and make wise decisions when working alone. Respecting others and maintaining good relationships will also make your journey easier and more rewarding. Although teamwork can be helpful, sometimes not everyone works with the same dedication. Therefore, focusing on your individual work ethic is essential for personal growth and success.

Emerson’s statement reflects his own experience; by being true to himself, he made important decisions that shaped his life. Being an individual means developing the unique qualities that separate you from others. This individuality is crucial because relying solely on a team may not always guarantee progress if some members lack commitment. Consistent hard work and dedication to your own goals will lead to personal achievement and a better future.

True accomplishment comes from perseverance and believing in your efforts. When you remain focused and determined, the results of your work will show, and you will feel proud of what you have achieved. Being yourself in a world that often pressures you to change is not easy, but it is worth every effort.

In conclusion, the key to a successful and fulfilling life is to work hard for your future while staying true to yourself. Make thoughtful decisions and treat others with respect because these actions will support your path. Remember, your future depends on your own efforts and choices. Even when facing difficulties, never stop working towards your goals, and you will find happiness in your achievements. Stay positive and believe in yourself.

In China, we do not follow the idea that Ralph Waldo Emerson suggested. Emerson believed that a person grows by striving beyond what they have already mastered. However, I think people are different, and not everyone improves by going beyond what they already know well. Sometimes, even if someone goes beyond the familiar challenges they have faced, it does not always mean they have truly grown. I disagree with Emerson’s view for three main reasons: learning new things helps people grow, small but important experiences can help people mature, and various aspects of life can contribute to personal growth.

Firstly, people can develop by exploring and learning new things that are unfamiliar to them. These new experiences are beyond their current knowledge or skills. For example, my mother did not know any English when she first came to America. She spent three years learning the language and now she can communicate a little in English. No one can deny that she has grown because she learned something she never knew before. Her story shows that growth does not only come from going beyond what we have already mastered, but also from discovering entirely new things.

Secondly, small but significant moments can help people grow. In science experiments, even a tiny mistake can ruin the entire experiment. Students learning science realize how important it is to avoid small errors because these can have big consequences. This kind of awareness helps them mature because they understand how little things can affect the larger picture. From this example, I have learned that minor details can become very important and influence your life in unexpected ways.

Finally, many life experiences contribute to personal growth. When people move from school into society, they notice major differences. In the workplace, they learn that simply working hard does not guarantee success; there are many ways to advance in life. Understanding this shows that a person is becoming more mature. Additionally, getting married and having children teaches what true responsibility means. Responsibility is a key part of what it means to grow up. Work, marriage, children, and other experiences all help a person develop into an adult.

For example, one student might handle one section, another student could design the project, and someone else might be responsible for research. If someone finishes early, they can offer assistance to teammates. For instance, a student working alone might struggle and need extra time, so volunteers from the group can help with the difficult parts.

In conclusion, collaborating in groups teaches students to listen to others' thoughts and work together effectively. Just like in a family, where you decide how to care for your loved ones, it is better not to depend on others who might not understand your situation. You must build your own “family” of decisions and rules by yourself.

Firstly, being alone allows you to learn from your own mistakes and gain valuable experience. When you make decisions independently, you may sometimes make errors, but these mistakes teach you important lessons. These lessons help you become more responsible and stronger in your actions. Learning from failure helps you develop a better understanding of what works and what doesn’t. By contrast, creating your own guidelines helps you become wiser and more independent.

Finally, being on your own means no one will bother or interrupt your choices. You take full responsibility for your actions and become the leader of your own life. Relying on others’ advice can sometimes create pressure because they may try to correct or influence you according to their viewpoints. This can make you feel constrained and force you to follow a path you don’t want. When you go your own way, you avoid such problems and have the freedom to experience life as you wish.

In conclusion, individuals should make their own decisions rather than depending on experts or others with more experience. Starting from scratch and learning from mistakes helps you grow stronger and more confident. For all these reasons, it is better to be alone and trust your own decisions instead of following others.

Starting an after-school homework club in my school would be an effective way to help students improve their academic performance. Many students struggle with completing their homework without assistance, and having teachers available to support them after school would allow these students to better understand the material they learn in class. This extra help could reduce confusion during tests, resulting in higher scores because students would have the chance to study and ask questions with their teachers’ guidance. However, some students dislike doing homework and refuse to stay after school even when invited, which can frustrate teachers who dedicate their time to help but find that students do not show up.

Teachers often sacrifice their personal time to assist students with homework, hoping they will complete assignments and achieve good grades. Some teachers are strict about deadlines and may stop giving extensions because certain students repeatedly fail to finish their work on time. They explain to these students that their grades will reflect their choices, whether that means earning A’s or failing. To make the homework club effective, only those who need help should stay after school, rather than having multiple teachers supervising separate sessions. Unfortunately, some students disregard the effort teachers put into these programs and even throw away their homework, showing a lack of respect for the education they receive.

There are students who complete their homework early and could serve as peer tutors in the after-school club, helping classmates who find the work difficult. Yet, when students are allowed to help each other, they sometimes get distracted by chatting or playing instead of focusing on the assignments. Interestingly, students tend to work better when they are grouped with peers they don’t know well. Still, some students prefer receiving help only from teachers because their classmates might give them answers without explaining the process. This can cause problems if teachers ask how they arrived at the answer, and the students cannot explain it, revealing that they copied.

Student academic achievement would improve significantly with an after-school homework club staffed by teachers and volunteers willing to support those struggling. Many students either forget to complete their homework or simply do not understand it well enough to finish on their own. Attending the club would reduce the challenges they face with assignments. In some subjects without regular homework, students still claim to have too much work or forget to do projects, even after being offered extra help. Some prefer to accept poor grades instead of putting in the effort to complete their homework.

Some students like to finish homework early during free time in class because they do not want to stay after school. They ask teachers or classmates for help so that they can complete their assignments and avoid extra work at home, allowing them to relax without worrying about unfinished tasks. If students prefer not to collaborate with peers, they can always stay with a teacher for guidance. Many educators encourage students to assist one another, believing that explaining concepts to classmates helps everyone understand the subject better and fosters more questions and discussions.

Many students could raise their grades and complete homework early if parents cooperated by encouraging attendance at the after-school club. Often, students forget about homework while playing after school and deny having assignments when asked at home. However, when teachers contact parents to inform them that their child has missed homework and is failing the class, some students still do not take the work seriously. To motivate students, teachers could reward those who attend the club and finish their assignments on time, making them feel proud of their progress.

Implementing an after-school club in other schools would also help students prepare for tests, as doing homework regularly reinforces learning. Without homework practice, students may find exams much more difficult. Some schools do not support homework clubs because they assume everyone understands the work and no one asks for help or brings assignments to class. Teachers may believe students have forgotten their homework at home and accept excuses, giving good grades despite incomplete work. Meanwhile, some students volunteer their time to help struggling classmates, but these helpers are often not appreciated by those they assist or others who refuse to participate.

In conclusion, establishing a dedicated after-school homework club would greatly benefit students who need extra support. With committed teachers and volunteers, students could improve their understanding, complete assignments on time, and achieve better grades, all while fostering a stronger learning community.

Ralph Waldo Emerson once said, "To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment." In today’s fast-paced life, staying true to your individuality is indeed a remarkable achievement. Being different, maintaining a healthy sense of self, and not losing your identity are important for mental well-being and personal growth.

I agree with Emerson’s idea. Nowadays, everyone wants to stand out and be unique, whether it’s a musician, an artist, or a teacher. For example, a teacher might try to do something special with their students that no one else has done before. This effort makes the teacher unique, although the results can be either good or bad. People might judge the teacher, but the world constantly tries to shape you into something different. As Emerson mentioned, this pressure to change is part of what challenges you to become your true self.

There are always negative people trying to change you or criticize you. In my opinion, this can actually make you stronger. Why? Because it depends on how you see things. We can be unique in our own way, and we can also be inspired by those who came before us—family members, artists, or people who achieved something extraordinary. This inspiration can guide us to be unique. Take, for example, the creator of Facebook—someone who introduced a new idea that changed the way we connect, bringing positive changes to society.

Life follows a cycle: we are born, grow up, reproduce, and eventually die. During the growing-up phase, we learn that we must make important decisions. For instance, when asked, "What do you want to be when you grow up?" we realize that choosing a path in life is essential to contribute something meaningful to the world. A teenager deciding on a college major is an example of this. Even though others may judge you or criticize your choice, it doesn’t matter in the end. You have only one life to live, and the way you spend it is your own decision. However, it’s important to make wise choices.

In summary, being yourself despite the pressure to conform is a significant accomplishment. While people may try to change or judge you, staying true to your uniqueness is what truly matters in life.

If this rule is put in place, teenagers caught outside after those times would be violating the law. The question is whether curfews actually prevent young people from getting into trouble or if they unfairly restrict their freedom.

Curfews can play an important role in keeping teenagers safe because being out late at night can be risky. For instance, wandering the streets after dark increases the chance of encountering dangerous situations, such as being kidnapped or ending up in the wrong place at the wrong time. While some teens might think that staying out late is exciting, the reality is that it can lead to serious problems. If police stop a teenager during curfew hours, they often ask if the teen’s parents know where they are. If the answer is no, the police will contact the parents to pick them up, which can cause trouble.

Parents often feel worried when their children don’t come home on time. Although teenagers want to hang out with friends, they should consider whether staying out late is worth the risk, especially since those friends may not always support them in difficult situations. Curfews help protect teenagers by setting clear boundaries. At the same time, having a curfew is a sign that parents care and expect their children to be responsible. The night can be dangerous because it’s harder to see clearly, and risks like drunk drivers increase after dark.

Since curfews are enforced by law, breaking them means committing an offense. Police take this seriously because their goal is to keep young people safe and encourage them to obey their parents. While teens often believe that meeting friends late at night is fun, parents want their children to behave responsibly so they avoid serious trouble. It’s important to prioritize parental trust over friendships that might not last. This is why curfews exist—as a way to encourage respect for parents and family rules.

Moreover, curfews help prevent teens from making poor choices. Many young people think their parents won’t find out about their late outings, but when parents receive a call from the police, teens often feel nervous or scared because they don’t know how to explain themselves. Parents can be very aware when their kids sneak out. Teenagers do have a choice: they can either stay home or go out, but they should remember that adults care about their safety. Instead of wandering the streets alone, teens can rest or enjoy activities like video games. They can also spend time with friends during the day or have sleepovers, which are safer options. Sneaking out just to meet friends or get food puts teens at unnecessary risk.

In conclusion, the best choice for teenagers is to avoid trouble and maintain their parents’ trust. They should stay home, study, watch a movie, or find other enjoyable activities indoors instead of sneaking out to do things that could lead to problems. Respecting curfews is a way to stay safe and keep a good relationship with family.
